name: drone-website-stress-test
description: AeroApex 前后端全链路压力测试模块：前端静态资源吞吐、真实浏览器渲染与交互压测、监控 SDK 高频上报压测、后端 API 全链路压测与可视化报告生成。

scripts.preflight: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js --env local --check-only
scripts.preflight:staging: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js --env staging --check-only
scripts.stress: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js --env local
scripts.stress:staging: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js --env staging
scripts.stress:capacity: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js --env staging --capacity
scripts.stress:smoke: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js --profile smoke
scripts.stress:frontend: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js --suite frontend
scripts.stress:backend: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js --suite backend
scripts.stress:browser: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js --suite browser
scripts.stress:sdk: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js --suite sdk
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
